Developer Docs

Auth: x-api-key header ya ?api_key= param — dono chalega.

⚡ Quick Start
🐍 yt.py + .env
📡 Endpoints
🧪 Try It
# 1) Key lo — bot se ya upar "Get Free Key" se
# 2) Koi bhi endpoint test karo:
curl "https://sole-merry-listings-studies.trycloudflare.com/search?q=kesariya&api_key=YOUR_KEY"

# 3) Stream URL (audio):
curl "https://sole-merry-listings-studies.trycloudflare.com/api/stream?url=https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ&type=audio&api_key=YOUR_KEY"

Response: {"ok": true, "stream_url": "https://…googlevideo.com/videoplayback?…"} # VC me direct play

Key ke saath yt.py download karo (apne bot ke platforms/ me drop karo) aur .env me 2 lines daalo — bas, bot chalu. 🚀

# .env — bot me add karo (KeyaraAPI)
HELLAPI_URL=https://sole-merry-listings-studies.trycloudflare.com
HELLAPI_KEY=Keyara…your-key…
⬇️ Download yt.py (key ke saath)
METHODENDPOINTKAAM
GET/search?q=YouTube search (library-first)
GET/api/stream?url=&type=Audio/Video stream URL
GET/song?videoid=AnonX/Yukki-style song link
GET/info?url=Video metadata
GET/ytdl?url=&format=yt-dlp style raw
GET/api/live?url=LIVE HLS stream
GET/library/search?q=2,327 song library
GET/plansPlans + pricing
GET/youtube.pyDrop-in platform client
GET/site-freekeyInstant free key (website)
GET/redeemPaid code → plan activate
